title: Care-Stay Credits Netted on the Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter
content:
For the annual tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement**, the stay nightly charges counted are those of Larkspur care stays, every stay type other than the Independent Living Trial Stay, and depend on how the stays ended: where the window holds an early-departure credit, the nightly charges are counted net of the early-departure credits; where it holds a level-change adjustment credit and no early-departure credit, the nightly charges are counted net of the level-change adjustment credits; otherwise the nightly charges count in full.

## Records read

Nightly charges and credits on the resident's **Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement** ledger within the letter's window, the credits identified by their reason: early departure, or level-change adjustment.

## Condition table

| Early-departure credit in the window | Level-change adjustment credit in the window | Nightly charges counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Net of the early-departure credits |
| No | Yes | Net of the level-change adjustment credits |
| No | No | In full |

## Hypothetical windows (care-stay nightly charges 5400.00)

| Early-departure credits | Level-change credits | Charges counted |
|---|---|---|
| 600.00 | 300.00 | 4800.00 |
| 0.00 | 300.00 | 5100.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 | 5400.00 |

Trial-stay nightly charges are not among the charges counted whatever credits the window holds.
